data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2024 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 533.279m and experienced aggregate prior-year adverse development of approximately GBP 38.761m (7.27% of opening gross reserves), driven primarily by natural catastrophe-related large losses in 2022 and adverse development on older underwriting years. The report cites specific 2022 events (Hurricane Ian, Winter storm Elliott, Hawaii wildfires) and notes overall attritional loss development largely within expectations, but the quantified prior-year strengthening was calculated from the gross claims development triangle.
raw_causal_phrases: The recent trend of climate related losses continued into 2022 with market losses above the 5-year average.
For the third year in a row underlying attritional losses have continued to develop within our expectations.
Underlying attritional loss development has continued to be within our expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not provided as a single gross aggregate in narrative; computed from the gross claims development triangle (excluded two most recent underwriting years) per instructions. RITC of 2020 & prior by a third party (Syndicate 3500) is noted in the report and may distort older years; triangle columns for 'X and prior' were excluded. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision - gross' figure was present; hence triangle-derived value used.
